name: Liben
description:
After you Discard a card: this card gains +1 progress.
During the Preparation Phase, if progress is at least 4: choose to either harvest the Box o' Marvels or continue accumulating progress. (When progress exceeds 8/12/20, the Box o' Marvels will be upgraded accordingly!)
